svg.title: (a) TriFlow-SA — top-level hardware architecture
svg.text: W = DATA_W; P = ACC_W; N = array dimension. Register banks, boundary muxes, PE mesh, and control are explicit.
A/B/C are flop banks with parallel taps; no SRAM macro is implied.
Solid buses: operands / partial sums / results. Dashed wires: control and status. Register triangles denote the clock.
